integrity: Closed-form proof reconstructed from volume slices, triangular-face moments and antipodal vertex complexity; numerical checks independently corroborated, without claiming external verification.
scientific_limitations: Exact threshold applies to the one-parameter family and the fixed convex coordinate-square witness, not to all convex tests, six-vertex shapes, or mean-distance moments. Related recent full texts were not all fully accessible; priority comparisons have residual risks.
title: A six-vertex convex-order obstruction with a sharp bipyramid threshold
